evals.prompt: /release v0.3.0 with three stories at built, each with a PASS verify report and no deferral, and [release].platform = "kubernetes"
evals.expected_output: .devforgeai/releases/v0.3.0.yaml at status: released and four Kubernetes manifests.
expectations: The sixteen top-level keys appear in the Outputs order: schema, id, phase, status, produced_by, consumes, open_questions, previous_version, released_at, stories, artifacts, platform, deploy, docs, notes, signoff.
stories[] holds three entries ascending by id.
platform.target is 'kubernetes' and platform.source is 'config'.
deploy.manifests[] holds deployment.yaml, service.yaml, ingress.yaml, and kustomization.yaml.
signoff.gate is 'PASS'.

evals.prompt: /release v0.3.0 with [release].platform = "" and a docker-compose.yaml at the project root
evals.expected_output: The release file with platform.source: detected.
expectations: platform.target is 'compose'.
platform.marker is 'docker-compose.yaml'.
deploy/compose/docker-compose.yaml and deploy/compose/env.example both exist.
Every ${NAME} reference in the compose file has a NAME= line in env.example.

evals.prompt: /release v0.3.0 with [release].platform = "none" on a library project
evals.expected_output: The release file with no manifest.
expectations: deploy.manifests is [].
deploy.rollback is the empty string.
No file exists under deploy/.
docs/api/index.md, docs/guide/index.md, and docs/architecture/index.md all exist.
The run printed a PASS handoff.

evals.prompt: /release v0.3.0 where one story's QA report defers FIND-009 with the reason 'Deferred to STORY-031' on an authentication control
evals.expected_output: A SEND BACK handoff to Verify.
expectations: The handoff Gate line reads 'SEND BACK to Verify'.
A Found line names FIND-009 and STORY-017.
The handoff Next line is '/verify STORY-017 --remedy FIND-009'.
The handoff Then line is '/release v0.3.0 --resume'.
No story file moved to status: released.

evals.prompt: /release v0.3.0 where STORY-021 is at built and reports/STORY-021-verify.yaml carries gate.result: FAIL
evals.expected_output: A SEND BACK handoff to Verify citing the story.
expectations: The handoff Gate line names release-stories.
The handoff Next line cites STORY-021.
releases/v0.3.0.yaml carries signoff.gate: SEND_BACK.
stories[] still lists STORY-021 with verify_result: FAIL.

evals.prompt: /release v0.3.0 --resume after the deferral send-back, with FIND-009 now closed in the QA report
evals.expected_output: A PASS handoff with the manifests untouched.
expectations: The handoff Gate line reads 'PASS'.
Every file under deploy/ has the byte content it had before the resume.
notes.deferred[] holds no entry with blocks_deployment: true.
The handoff Next line is '/reflect v0.3.0'.

evals.expected_output: The run stops before writing a release file.
expectations: The run reports that the version is not greater than v0.3.0.
.devforgeai/releases/v0.2.0.yaml does not exist.
No file was written under deploy/ or docs/.
The run printed no PASS gate line.

evals.prompt: /release v0.3.0 with [release].api_symbols_command printing 12 symbols and docs/api/ written for one stack
evals.expected_output: The API pages covering every symbol.
expectations: docs/api/index.md '## Symbols' holds 12 data rows.
The docs/api page for the stack holds 12 H3 headings whose text equals the symbol names.
docs.api_symbols and docs.api_documented are both 12.
docs.brand lists the two copied brand files.

evals.prompt: /release v0.3.0 over three stories: one whose consumes holds FIND-004, one whose consumes holds no REQ-nnn, one holding two REQ-nnn
evals.expected_output: The release notes with the three derived kinds.
expectations: notes.entries holds three entries in stories[] order.
The kinds are fix, internal, and feature in the order the stories sort.
notes.requirements is the ascending de-duplicated union of the entries' requirement ids.
notes.summary is at most 72 characters.
